headline: Fresh Strongpoint Battles Mark 242nd Day of War
war_summary: Since the last wire, Stonecradle and the Weathered Expanse have returned to the battle sheet after quiet passes; Stonecradle recorded five strategic-base events in the latest two-hour watch and the Expanse four. Stlican Shelf likewise posted four, prolonging a seesaw now spread across almost evenly divided strongpoints. DeadLands, absent from recent reports, broke out with three events around Callahan's Gate, including a Warden capture in a largely Colonial-held map. The Expanse remains the war's costliest sector, with casualties rising on both sides in the latest hourly readings. Farranac Coast still draws heavy fire but has had no base change inside the final two-hour window; Godcrofts, the day's most prodigious battlefield, has likewise gone quiet since the afternoon, as has Fisherman's Row. It is the 242nd day of the campaign, and neither army has claimed the thirty-four towns the war requires.
